summary: Austria general functionality in Business Central covers audit-related tools: exporting GL and VAT entries for auditing with the Audit Files Export extension, and printing general ledger setup information in the Austrian version. It answers questions about audit data exports and verifying setup for compliance.
overview:
This section groups two audit-related pages under the Austria local functionality section of Business Central. One describes exporting data for auditors. The other describes a report in the Austrian version that prints the general ledger setup so you can check it.

The export page explains the Audit Files Export extension, which exports GL and VAT entries in formats such as SIE, FEC, and SAF-T. It also covers GL account mapping, data quality checks, parallel processing, and zip export. The setup page covers the G/L Setup Information report, which prints general ledger master data, posting groups, VAT setup, and source codes for verification and audit compliance.

Use the setup report page when you need to review or verify general ledger configuration. Use the export page when you need to produce audit data files from GL and VAT entries.
key_points: The Audit Files Export extension exports GL and VAT entries for auditing.
Export formats named include SIE, FEC, and SAF-T.
The export supports GL account mapping, data quality checks, parallel processing, and zip export.
The G/L Setup Information report is part of the Austrian version of Business Central.
The report prints general ledger master data, posting groups, VAT setup, and source codes.
The report shows the G/L Setup, Posting Groups, Posting Matrix, VAT Setup, and Source Code, and includes a Check Number Series option.
The report is meant for verification and audit compliance.

issues: The overview suggested a workflow (run the setup report first, then the export page) that neither page summary supports. I replaced it with neutral guidance on which page to use when.

The overview called both pages Austria-specific. Only the G/L Setup Information page says it is part of the Austrian version. The export page sits under the Austria section, but its summary does not say it is Austria-only. I reworded this.
Minor: the extension is called 'Audit Files Export' in the page summary and 'Audit File Export' in its feature list. The narrative uses the summary's spelling, which is fine.
Minor: key point 6 calls Check Number Series an 'option'. The source only lists it as a feature, but this is a reasonable reading.
